_doc.purpose: Authoritative, executable module-boundary rule for contrejour. The constitution prose is descriptive; THIS file + check-boundaries.mjs are normative.
_doc.modules: Pipeline modules under packages/ and apps/. packages/api is the orchestrator and is intentionally not listed, so it may import engine.
_doc.allowedSharedTargets: canon is the domain layer. engine may import canon types only.
_doc.ratchet: stdlib is always allowed. Pre-existing debt does not block; only an increase per severity class fails.
